events.title: Tottori Sand Dunes
events.description: Japan’s largest coastal sand dunes—camel rides and desert views by the Sea of Japan.

events.title: The Sand Museum
events.description: Spectacular themed sand-sculpture exhibits near the dunes (seasonal).

events.title: Tottori Castle Ruins (Kyūshō Park)
events.description: Castle remains on Mt. Kyūshō with city and sea vistas.
